content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe's platform restrictions have forced digital creators to abandon their online stores. The lack of infrastructure sovereignty has left them at the mercy of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-explained-digital-creators|Payment Methods]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-what-actually-how|payment]] gateways, unable to collect revenue from their digital products. This is where Supabase comes in as a powerful order database, allowing creators to build sovereign digital stores without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Supabase order

Supabase, a PostgreSQL-compatible open-source database, provides a robust and scalable foundation for digital stores. Its flexible schema and real-time data synchronization enable seamless order processing and management. By integrating Supabase with NOWPayments and GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, creators can build a sovereign digital store that withstands platform restrictions. This infrastructure stack, dubbed Stack 01, can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, allowing creators to quickly adapt to the changing payment landscape.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a Supabase-based digital store, you'll need a few essential tools and knowledge. Firstly, you'll require a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your store's frontend. Secondly, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account to handle on-chain cryptocurrency payments. Additionally, you'll need to familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a comprehensive guide to deploying Stack 01. With these tools and knowledge in hand, you'll be well-prepared to build a sovereign digital store that's resistant to platform failures.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up a seamless payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with Supabase and your store's frontend. This involves configuring Webhook triggers to send payment and order updates to Supabase, which can then be used to synchronize data across your digital store. By automating this process, you'll be able to efficiently manage orders and payments, ensuring a smooth customer experience. Furthermore, you can configure your store to automatically deliver digital products to customers once payment has been confirmed.
Supabase provides a robust and scalable foundation for digital stores, with real-time data synchronization and flexible schema.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you're ready to go live. You'll need to test your store with a few sample transactions to ensure that everything is working as expected. This involves processing a payment, verifying the transaction, and delivering the digital product to the customer. By following these steps, you'll be able to confidently launch your digital store and start processing transactions. With Stack 01, you'll be able to handle multiple transactions per second, making it an ideal solution for high-traffic digital stores.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'How do I ensure the security and integrity of my digital store data?' The answer is simple: by using a robust and scalable database like Supabase, which provides end-to-end encryption, regular backups, and real-time data synchronization. This ensures that your customer data remains safe and secure, even in the face of platform failures or cyber threats.
By integrating Supabase with NOWPayments and GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, creators can build a sovereign digital store that withstands platform restrictions.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a Supabase-based digital store, follow these concrete steps: Create a new GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account to host your store's frontend. Set up a NOWPayments account to handle on-chain cryptocurrency payments. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a comprehensive guide to deploying Stack 01. Configure Webhook triggers to send payment and order updates to Supabase. Automate the delivery of digital products to customers once payment has been confirmed. Test your store with sample transactions to ensure everything is working as expected. Monitor your store's performance and optimize your infrastructure as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I order by two columns in Supabase?
You can order by two columns in Supabase by using the ORDER BY clause with multiple column names. For example: `SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id ASC;`
Is Supabase good for databases?

Supabase is an ideal choice for databases due to its scalability, flexibility, and robust security features. Its PostgreSQL-compatible architecture and real-time data synchronization make it an excellent solution for high-traffic digital stores.
How to export Supabase database data?

To export Supabase database data, you can use the SQL export feature, which allows you to download your data in CSV, JSON, or other formats. Additionally, you can use third-party tools or APIs to export your data in various formats.
Can I use Supabase with other payment gateways?

Yes, you can use Supabase with other payment gateways, but it's recommended to use NOWPayments for its seamless integration and robust security features. Other payment gateways may require custom integration and additional setup.
How do I configure Webhook triggers in Supabase?

To configure Webhook triggers in Supabase, you'll need to create a new Webhook in the Supabase dashboard and specify the trigger events, such as payment or order updates. You can then configure the Webhook URL to send notifications to your store's frontend or other services.
